CHAPTER.VERS: I Lift up my eyes to you,who are throned in the heavens.
As the eyes of a servantturn to the hand of his master,or the eyes of a maidto the hand of her mistress,so do our eyes turnto the our God,until he is gracious to us.
Be gracious, be gracious to us, .Scorn enough, and more, have we borne
More than enough have we borneof derision from those at their ease,of scorn from those who are haughty.
